definition: Regional weighted average transaction price per kg at wholesale markets.
Production season shifts that affect sourcing weights and price volatility.
Certified farm-to-table production and sales record; assets tagged traceability participate in the certified chain.
Per-serving ingredient cost derived by joining recipe quantity maps with current wholesale prices.
The full data chain: farm (dim_farm) → harvest lot → procurement lot → ingredient → recipe. Money (TWD), time (season/lead time), and region (TW-*) facets attach at each hop.
